edges.rationale: SectionsManager component is the default export defined inside SectionsManager.jsx.
openCreateForm and closeForm reset formData to DEFAULT_SECTION_FORM when opening or cancelling the modal.
selectedPresetId is seeded from SSC_CGL_2025_PRESETS[0].id and the dropdown iterates the preset list.
useEffect([testId]) invokes fetchData on mount and whenever the test filter changes.
handleSubmit runs validateSection(formData, editingId) before posting the section.
The Apply to Test button triggers applyPreset() to bulk-create sections from the chosen preset.
The form onSubmit prop binds to handleSubmit.
The Delete action button on each row calls handleDelete(section.id).
Reorder actions (e.g. up/down controls) call handleReorder(sectionId, newOrder) to persist display_order.
The 5-card stats grid reads total/active/withQuestions/plannedQuestions/plannedMarks from the stats memo.
The modal is rendered inline within SectionsManager when showForm is true.
filteredSections are rendered in the table view within the manager.
fetchData uses apiClient.get(/api/admin/sections) to load sections.
fetchData calls adminAPI.getTestCategories() and adminAPI.getTests() to populate dropdowns.
handleSubmit runs validateForm(sectionSchema, {...}) for Zod-based form validation.
Submits via apiClient.put or apiClient.post against /api/admin/sections.
handleDelete calls apiClient.delete(/api/admin/sections/:id).
handleReorder calls apiClient.put to update display_order.
applyPreset fans out apiClient.post(/api/admin/sections) for each preset row, deduping existing names.
applyPreset looks up the chosen preset from SSC_CGL_2025_PRESETS by selectedPresetId and iterates its sections array.
apiClient is the wrapper that issues HTTP requests to the backend /api/admin/sections endpoints.
filteredSections (consumed downstream) maps through normalizeSection, so the fetched data flows into it before render; the indirect call is in the data pipeline.
The modal initializes formData from DEFAULT_SECTION_FORM when opening create or close.
Modal form element wires onSubmit to handleSubmit.
openEditForm calls normalizeSection(section) before populating the form so legacy and new keys both work.
The presets concept is encoded as the SSC_CGL_2025_PRESETS constant for Tier-I/II structures.
The key normalization rationale is implemented by the normalizeSection helper handling both naming conventions.
The seconds-based storage decision drives the 60-second minimum rule inside validateSection.
The documented validation rules are the explicit rules implemented in validateSection.
The Delete icon button in the table actions column triggers handleDelete(section.id).
The Scheme column renders exam_stage/paper/session/section_code whose values come from preset-driven sections, but the table does not directly call applyPreset.
The /api/admin/sections routes are configured server-side and consumed through the shared apiClient wrapper.
